about.title: Über Spootfind
about.subtitle: Dein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für globale Produktbeschaffung
about.storyContent: Spootfind entstand aus einer einfachen Idee: globale Beschaffung für alle zugänglich machen. Wir verbinden Käufer weltweit mit Trendprodukten aus den wichtigsten Produktionszentren in China, Korea, Japan und mehr.
about.missionContent: Globalen Handel demokratisieren durch transparente, zuverlässige und effiziente Beschaffungslösungen für Unternehmen aller Größen.
about.value1Desc: Jedes Produkt und jeder Lieferant wird auf Qualität geprüft
about.value2Desc: Klare Preise, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine versteckten Gebühren
about.step1Desc: Durchstöbere unsere kuratierte Auswahl der meistverkauften Produkte von Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy und mehr.
about.step2Desc: Nutze unseren integrierten Rechner, um exakte Kosten, Versand und Gewinnmargen vor dem Kauf zu sehen.
about.step3Desc: Kontaktiere verifizierte Lieferanten direkt und gib deine Bestellung mit Vertrauen auf.
about.faqA1: Wir arbeiten mit verifizierten Herstellern hauptsächlich in China, Südkorea und Japan zusammen. Jeder Lieferant in unserem Netzwerk wird auf Qualität und Produktionskapazität geprüft.
about.faqA2: Mindestbestellmengen variieren je nach Produkt, typischerweise ab 20-50 Einheiten. Wir arbeiten sowohl mit Kleineinkäufern als auch mit Großbestellungen.
about.faqQ3: Wie lange dauert der internationale Versand?
about.faqA3: Luftfracht dauert typischerweise 7-14 Tage; Seefracht dauert 25-40 Tage. Wir arbeiten mit den wichtigsten Logistikpartnern zusammen.
about.faqA4: Wir bieten einen Qualitätsprüfservice für Bestellungen über 500$. Wir bieten auch Unterstützung bei der Streitbeilegung.
about.storyExpanded: Seit unserem Start verbinden wir weltweite Einkaufer mit den besten chinesischen Lieferanten und bieten Trendprodukte mit garantieter Qualitat und wettbewerbsfahigen Preisen.

insights.art2_title: Inside Jining's Mini Excavator Hub: What We Learned the Hard Way
insights.art2_subtitle: We're on the ground in Jining. Here's what we wish every buyer knew before their first container.
insights.art2_hotTitle: 🔥 We're Based in Jining. Here's What That Means for You.
insights.art2_hotContent:
We don't write this as outsiders. We're in Jining, walking factory floors every week. We've seen which factories deliver and which ones talk a good game.

What we've learned the hard way:
• The $2,500 "Kubota-spec" excavator is a lie. It's a generic diesel with a Kubota sticker. We know which factories actually use genuine Kubota engines — and which ones bluff.
• CE certificates can be faked. We've seen trading companies photoshop certificates from other factories. We verify the manufacturer name on the certificate against the contract before a single dollar moves.
• "Video tour" means nothing if it's a showroom. We ask to see the engine test rig. If they don't have one, they're assembling, not manufacturing.
• Spare parts availability is where most buyers get burned 6 months later. We only work with factories that stock spare parts and can ship within 48 hours. We've tested this.

We're not a marketplace. We're your people on the ground in Jining.
insights.art2_profitTitle: 💰 The 5 Mistakes We've Seen Buyers Make (So You Don't Have To)
insights.art2_profitContent:
Mistake #1: Paying for a "brand" that assembles from the same Jining suppliers as everyone else.
Our take: If it's got a Kubota engine and CE certification, you're paying for a sticker. We get you the same machine, same spec, without the brand markup. Ask us for a quote — you'll see the difference.

Mistake #2: Trusting the photos on Alibaba.
Our take: Photos are staged. We do unannounced factory visits. What we care about: Is the assembly line running? Do they have engines in stock? Can they show us a machine being test-run? We send you the unedited video.

Mistake #3: Not calculating total landed cost upfront.
Our take: We calculate it for you before you commit. Machine + shipping (we have forwarder rates most buyers don't) + duties + insurance. A $3,500 excavator typically lands at $5,500-7,000 depending on your port. We give you the exact number, not a range.

Mistake #4: Ordering a container before testing the market.
Our take: We always recommend starting with 1 unit. We'll source it, inspect it, and ship it to you. Test your market. If it sells, we scale with you. If it doesn't, you're out one machine, not a container deposit.

Mistake #5: Forgetting spare parts until something breaks.
Our take: We include a spare parts list with every quote. 10-15% extra on the first order. We've seen too many buyers stuck waiting 6 weeks for a drive belt. Not on our watch.
insights.art2_regionTitle: 🏭 Which Jining Factories We Work With (And Why)
insights.art2_regionContent:
We've vetted 40+ factories in Jining. We actively work with 6. Here's our criteria:

✅ Genuine Kubota OR Honda engines — we've seen the authorization letter from the engine supplier. No "Kubota-compatible" (that's code for "not genuine").

✅ Engine test rig on premises — this is the #1 filter. If they can't test-run an engine before installation, they're not a manufacturer. They're an assembler buying from someone else.

✅ Spare parts in stock — we've tested this. We order a bucket tooth on WeChat. If it ships within 48 hours, they pass. If they hemm and haw, they don't.

✅ Export-grade welding and paint — we check this in person. The "showroom unit" always looks good. We check the units actually being packed for shipping.

✅ RCM (Australia) and EPA (US) pre-certification available — most buyers don't know to ask for this upfront. We do. It saves 4-6 weeks of customs delays.

We're not the cheapest. We're the ones who've already made the mistakes so you don't have to.
insights.art2_tipsTitle: 📦 What We Handle (So You Don't Have To)
insights.art2_tipsContent:
✅ Factory verification — we visit in person, send unedited video
✅ Price negotiation — we speak the language, we know the margins, we get you better terms
✅ Quality inspection — we check the actual units being packed, not the showroom
✅ Shipping coordination — our forwarder rates vs. what you'd get on your own: typically 15-20% less
✅ Customs paperwork — CE/EPA/RCM certificates verified before a dollar moves
✅ Spare parts fulfillment — we maintain a spare parts inventory so you're not waiting
✅ After-sales liaison — when something breaks, you don't want to be on WeChat at 2am arguing with a factory. That's our job.

MOQ starts at 1 unit for testing. Most of our buyers scale to 5-10 units after the first machine proves out.
